Outlaw Rogue DPS Stat Priority — 12.1

1.

Outlaw Rogue Stat Priority

For raiding and Mythic+, the secondary stat priority for Outlaw Rogue is largely the same. The only meaningful difference between single-target and AoE, is that you do not play Blade Rush in single-target builds, which makes Haste a bit more valuable, so try to aim for 30% in a raid gear setup, while ～25% is enough for Mythic+ dungeons. The general stat priority is as follows:

Item Level
Critical Strike to 40%
Haste to 25%
Versatility
Mastery

The value of Haste and Crit are somewhat dependent on how much of it you already have. Crit starts losing in value once you reach ～40% Crit, while Haste drops off at around 25-30% once you reach the breakpoint for getting a 0.8sec GCD during Adrenaline Rush. While you generally avoid stacking stats on every single gear piece, you want to make sure you are close enough to these "breakpoints", as long as you do not drop itemlevel for it.

You will likely want to prioritize Haste and Critical Strike on many pieces, and take as much Versatility as is unavoidable to get.

Optimization
Simulations and Tools
While a generalized stat priority will assist new players, there really is no substitute for simming your character. Learn more with this guide!
